paragraphs: Appointed Guardian in the Will and Testament of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, Shoghi Effendi guided the development of the Faith’s administrative institutions, interpreted its teachings and translated its writings.

His ministry saw the launch of successive teaching plans, culminating in the Ten Year Crusade. After his passing in London on 4 November 1957, the Hands of the Cause guided the community through the remaining years of that plan until the election of the Universal House of Justice in 1963.
